pages.title: Zygomaturus
pages.text: $(o)Zygomaturus$() ($(o)Zygomaturus trilobus$()) was a bull-sized diprotodont that lived in southern and eastern Australia during the Late Pleistocene.$(br2)It had a broad, short skull with a raised nasal area, and probably lived in wetter forests and around swamps.$(br2)Its strong jaws may have let it feed on reeds and sedges as well as shrubs.
